newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins firmer tracking US Treasuries.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins firmer tracking US Treasuries.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds firmed in thin trading following U.S. Treasuries and on hopes Russia would adopt its 1997 budget on Sunday, dealers said on Monday.

The State Duma lower house of parliament last week postponed a vote on the 1997 budget to Sunday. December 12 and 13 are Constitution Day holidays in Russia, while Saturday and Sunday December 14 and 15 are working days.
"Prices were too low after the fall (last week). This is why it is no surprise the opposite trend has started. Buying is seen both abroad and in Moscow," one dealer said.
But dealers said volume traded remains low ahead of the New Year holidays.
"The market is pretty quiet. Buying is slight and it is on the back of firmer U.S. Treasuries and hopes Russia's budget will be passed," a Moscow Narodny Bank dealer said.
Dealers said the current levels are likely to remain this month, with fluctuations within 0.3 point.
